channel.title: Eleanora — the Journal
channel.description: An archive of her stories. New ones, as they land.

item.title: The Girl Behind the Camera (but also in front)
item.description: I've always had that face. The one you've seen somewhere before, so familiar you can't place it. The front door of the whole wheel, and the invitation to come with me.

item.title: The Good Girl (who was already gone)
item.description: I jumped ship for the first time right after my Confirmation. The story of the good girl who was already gone, and the map she built out of her own life.
